claims.text: Named Entity Recognition (NER) in the Biomedical domain involves recognizing entities such as proteins, genes, diseases, treatments, and drugs.
NER systems extract medical problems, tests, and treatments from clinical documents like discharge summaries and progress notes.
The biomedical domain presents unique challenges for NER, including reliance on hand-crafted features and fewer training examples compared to general text.
Recent advancements in NER utilize deep learning techniques to enhance performance, reducing the need for extensive feature engineering.
